definitions.no_anchor: Not present in frozen current R10 protocol; no results claimed.
definitions.llm_no_offline: Remove offline case evidence and its support gate; retain pretrained Anchor, residual selector, online proxy and LLM.
definitions.retrieval: Replace LLM action choice with maximum retrieved weighted 5-round gain among the same allowed actions; retain offline case evidence, history and action execution.
definitions.matched38: Disable adaptive LLM action control and fix default matched38 generation/fusion; broader than replacing only the decision maker.
